source_identity: Original author-labelled EMC after histological/immunohistochemical review, archived NationalTaiwanUniversityHospital pathology specimens. Anonymous/blinded specimens. No individual NR4A3 molecular confirmation, donor IDs, tumoursite, specimen date, grade, prior therapy or fresh-vs-recurrent condition crosswalk released for EMC in inspected tables/methods.

all_EMC_source_conditions.remaining_EMC_ALT: One specimen untested/unreported, reason not source-linked; not counted negative.
all_EMC_source_conditions.paired_ALT_ATRX: Table2 negativeALT stratum reports0/2 ATRXloss. This is an already published phenotype/protein comparison for the two tested specimens, not patient-linked TRAP/length.
all_EMC_source_conditions.DAXX: Main Results says all245tumours preservedDAXX. This encompasses the reported cohort but no EMC donor-specific DAXX intensity/crosswalk is supplied.
all_EMC_source_conditions.TRAP_or_other_telomerase_activity: Not measured/released for these EMC specimens in this paper.
all_EMC_source_conditions.absolute_telomere_length: Not measured/released for these EMC specimens in this paper.
all_EMC_source_conditions.technical_replication: No EMC-specific replicate-core,section,cell-count or serial condition map supplied; no independent replication inferred.

assay_method.ATRX_DAXX: SigmaAldrich antibodies1:500, performed as previously described(ref6), no EMC-specific staining intensity/clone or internal-control result supplied in this mainmethod.
assay_method.ALT: FITC-labelled peptide-nucleic-acid telomere probe, Panagene. ProteaseK time adjusted individually; usual180–360seconds for EMC and several other types. Telomere-FISH endpoint denotes source-defined ALT phenotype, not telomerase activity.
assay_method.criterion: Mainmethod imports criteria from Heaphy2011ref24 without restating threshold or positive/negative control results. Do not invent or reinterpret source images.
assay_method.specimen_preparation: Archived histological/IHC sections; decalcified conventional chondrosarcoma/osteosarcoma not FISH tested, source notes. Do not transfer that explanation to the untested EMC without individual information.
assay_method.images: No images/FISH inspection or numeric intensity extraction during active ban.
assay_method.positive_assay_context: The same paper reports ALT-positive sarcoma comparators, but that cohort context is not an independently authenticated run-control record for each negative EMC specimen.
assay_method.not_surrogates: RetainedATRX/DAXX does not rule out ALT. NegativeALT does not establish positive telomeraseactivity, nor absence of all maintenance mechanisms.

donor_overlap: The source separately marks previous myxoid-liposarcoma/epithelioid-hemangioendothelioma studies. EMC appears in currentTable2; no individual crosswalk to Koelsche2014 eight promoterWT cases or other series. Do not pool those studies as paired or proven independent.
value: Publishedtiny assay-negativeALT/retainedATRX observation already reusedR3, not new prevalence/clinical finding; no direct active-telomerase or length pairedcontrast.
